name: wolfchatter
description: Real-time chat on a Leaflet map

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/start/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/audit/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/load/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/ai/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
